steps.name: Agree requirements and direction
steps.instructions: As the main agent, read project rules, the high-level project specification and existing normative/current-behavior documents. For a new project, first follow the client-side project-onboarding procedure and verify the real Git origin and publication route before creating this Brief; agreement to set up the repository is separate from agreement on Brief requirements. Discuss the problem, expected user outcome, boundaries, dependencies and testable acceptance criteria with the human in their language or the language specified by AGENTS.md. Distinguish facts, assumptions and open questions. Explore proportionate normal, alternative, error and edge scenarios, including security-relevant cases. Number significant questions Q-01, Q-02, ... consecutively throughout this Brief (not anew per message or step); keep their answer, decision or unresolved status and rationale. When presenting a genuine choice, number its options 1., 2., ... and ask for a reply with one digit; option numbers are separate from Q IDs. Compare realistic high-level options when there is a genuine choice; record accepted and rejected approaches with reasons, not invented alternatives. Present the proposed required behavior, criteria, decisions, remaining questions and high-level delivery direction for explicit human approval. Do not decide product ambiguities on the human's behalf; consequential unresolved questions keep this step open. Technical implementation details permitted by project rules may be left to Execution. Before explicit agreement on Brief requirements, do not write KOS artifacts, create dependent tasks/groups or edit the normative project specification. If agreement cannot be reliably recovered, ask again. Do not advance without it.

steps.name: Record specification and decompose
steps.instructions: As the main agent, verify explicit human agreement against project rules and existing high-level specifications; resolve contradictory or lost decisions with the human before writing. Save approved high-level requirements, normative specification and implementation_plan in KOS. Keep the consecutive Brief Q numbers across the discussion and documents, with answers or explicit open status. For significant work use stable project/task-qualified REQ, AC and DEC IDs; link requirements, criteria, decisions with alternatives and rationale, questions and tasks, without tagging every code line. Record nonblocking questions with an owner and point of resolution; never silently convert an open product question into an approved requirement. Create at least one planned task using KOS Execution v1; create an epic group if needed. Create each dependent task atomically with blocked_by_ids including this Brief and other required blockers. Specify task outcome, boundaries, relevant criterion IDs and path to the normative specification. Inspect created IDs and dependencies; save planning_report with criterion-to-task coverage, gaps and relationships. Explicitly load kos-project-docs and prepare the approved normative Markdown document in the verified project worktree, at the project-defined path or docs/ by default. Describe what should hold independently of implementation progress. Review the draft and run applicable document checks. Reconcile partial failures against existing artifacts, files and tasks without duplicates; do not advance until results are complete.

steps.name: Publish and verify specification
steps.instructions: As the main agent, check the approved normative project file, links, KOS artifacts, criterion-to-task coverage and blocked dependencies. Inspect status, complete diff and project publication rules; run applicable checks and review the final changes. Publish the specification at the project-defined destination and independently verify the published revision there before completing Brief and unblocking its tasks. On prohibition or undefined destination seek a human decision; on ambiguous outcome inspect the destination before retrying. Preserve the worktree and do not create duplicate tasks. Save publication_report with document path, destination and verifiable revision/link; reconcile planning_report if needed. Only then complete Brief under the active claim.
